findings.description: check() now returns a list of violation messages that is empty when the report is within policy. decide() still uses `if check(report, rates):`, which is true when there are violations. Reports that break policy are auto-approved, and clean reports are sent to NEEDS_REVIEW.
findings.suggestion: Approve only when the list is empty: `if not check(report, rates): report.status = Status.APPROVED else: report.status = Status.NEEDS_REVIEW`.
findings.title: decide() treats the non-empty problem list as "within policy", inverting approval
